items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Leonard Bernstein was so carried away with his talent that they made him the concert master of that orchestra.

ctx.x: Leonard Bernstein was so carried away with his talent that they made him the concert master of that orchestra. And any time Leonard felt that he wanted to take a rest, he let Everett take the orchestra. And after they closed the season in New York and went on the road, he didn't leave New York. He sent Everett Lee with the outfit.
